name: Chikan Kenkyuushitsu
source:
It's the summer of 1999, Tokyo.

Due to his awful academic performance, Okita Takashi, a student in his fourth year at Tounan University has to undertake further special lessons during summer break given by Sagara Yuuko, the teacher responsible for the seminars he attends.

The topic of these lessons is on the "Psychology of Molestation".

His task is to hand in a research paper on this topic which is due by the beginning of the new semester. Furthermore, he is instructed that his research method will be to collect data from real-life experiences.

Not long after, Okita is readily investigating commuter trains or the internet to collect data samples.

The victims he chooses are six girls, each of different archetypes and ages.
All of them are virgins suffering under trauma.

- housewives whose marriage had turned cold
- high schoolers who give sex the cold shoulder
- female office employees with desires for getting raped

All of them have overlaps: They dwell in the big city, suffer under emotional and sexual dissatisfaction and their mental health took a deep dive.

While earning money from his part-time job Okita continues to molest for his report, but soon finds himself becoming more and more addicted to it.

And while he ventures into a abyrinth of disturbed desires, he might step over a line of which he won't be able to return anymore.

translation:
这是1999年的夏天，东京。

东南大学四年级学生冲田隆由于学习成绩不佳，不得不在暑假期间接受负责他参加研讨会的老师相良优子教授的进一步特殊课程。

这些课程的主题是“性骚扰心理学”。

他的任务是在新学期开始前提交一篇关于该主题的研究论文。此外，他被指示他的研究方法将是从现实生活经历中收集数据。

不久之后，冲田就开始调查通勤列车或互联网以收集数据样本。

他选择的受害者是六名女孩，每个女孩都有不同的原型和年龄。
她们都是饱受创伤的处女。

- 婚姻冷淡的家庭主妇
- 对性冷淡的高中生
- 渴望被强奸的女性办公室职员

他们都有重叠之处：他们居住在大城市，遭受情感和性方面的不满，心理健康状况严重恶化。

一边靠兼职赚钱，冲田一边继续骚扰他的报告，但很快发现自己越来越上瘾。

当他冒险进入欲望混乱的深渊时，他可能会跨过一条无法再返回的界限。
